note: Profiles whose SOUL does not yet state the canonical fleet block from agents/standing-rules.md (issue #873). An entry is legitimate only while it describes a REAL gap: once the profile states the block, `make check-agent-profiles` reports the entry STALE and it must be deleted. Each entry names the lane that owns the file, because only a lane may edit its own SOUL — and a gap with no owner is a gap nobody closes. Added 2026-11-04 (issue #1706): the fleet gained rule 15 — `The lane that opens a PR owns its CI until every required gate is green at the current head sha`. The rule landed in `standing-rules.md` first (docs-lane PR, #791 scope, no lane SOUL touched there), so every lane's SOUL now lags one bullet; each entry is that lane's real, owned debt to sync its own SOUL on the #1706 follow-up and delete its entry.
